overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the chair did not reasonably anticipate the Conservation Commission appointment until the day before or the day of the August 11 meeting, so it did not need to be on the 48-hour notice. The AG added reminders to postpone topics of public interest not noticed 48 hours ahead and not to use a non-member to relay matters the Board would otherwise discuss in open session.

allegations.summary: Alleged the Board discussed and voted on a Conservation Commission appointment on August 11 that was not listed on the 48-hour notice.
allegations.key_passage: We therefore find that, because the discussion was not anticipated 48 hours in advance, the Board was not required to list this topic in its meeting notice.
